contracts.boundary: bounded, session-scoped JSONL logging with short writes, overflow admission, metadata redaction, and reload rebinding
contracts.assertions: A complete payload survives controlled short writes and a partial write never merges into a later record; sparse arrays cannot bypass the node budget; drop-oldest, severity-first, and drop-newest all honor mixed severity and in-flight capacity; a reload re-binds the requesting session.

boundaryTest.name: writes the complete payload across controlled short writes

invariant.name: bounds sparse arrays without materializing every hole

fault.name: reports a failure after a short write instead of treating the batch as persisted

contracts.boundary: classifier transports and pipeline diagnostics stay attributed to the session that admitted the turn across async overlap
contracts.assertions: TypeSafe, pi-native, and prompt transport traces carry the captured identity instead of the process-global binding; an async classification diagnostic stays on the originating session.

boundaryTest.name: attributes transport traces to the captured classifier identity

invariant.name: attributes async classification diagnostics to the session that started the turn

fault.name: fault control: an undeclared pi-native trace key turns the per-backend allowlist assertion RED

contracts.boundary: host session lifecycle and reload keep classifier degradation notices and session identity visible
contracts.assertions: A reload re-binds the requesting session; classifier degradation notices deduplicate, re-arm after recovery, and never log prompt text.

boundaryTest.name: warns on a TypeSafe timeout, deduplicates its open circuit, and reports recovery without logging prompt text

invariant.name: logs every total-budget expiry while deduplicating warnings, then re-arms after a successful prompt result

fault.exception: The reload and degradation path is exercised by deterministic host-runtime tests; the source-mutation fault controls that bound index.ts live in the integration privacy and activation contracts.

contracts.boundary: generated project configuration preserves supported extension settings and excludes inherited classifier prompt text

invariant.name: allows valid enabled runtime preferences and fails closed on off or invalid preferences

fault.exception: Configuration generation is deterministic and fails closed on invalid input; no separate source mutation is retained for this boundary.

contracts.boundary: real Pi activation cancellation and late classifier results behind an isolated source fault
contracts.assertions: An aborted registry wait preserves a newer editor draft and a late classifier result never dispatches; removing the guard makes the named assertion fail.

invariant.name: does not dispatch after a late classifier result

contracts.boundary: within-tier affinity retains only an eligible anchor and drops it on branch change

fault.name: fails the named hard-exclusion assertion under a hard-filter-bypass fault in an isolated copy

contracts.boundary: classifier decision cache avoids repeated classification and invalidates on semantic-key change

contracts.boundary: classifier transports are attempted in order and stop on abort

invariant.name: does not start the minimal-session fallback prompt after abort
